scripts.aeos:bootstrap: npm run aeos:guard:no-python && npm run aeos:guard:skill-adapters && npm --prefix runtime run build
scripts.aeos:verify: npm run aeos:guard:no-python && npm run aeos:guard:skill-adapters && npm --prefix runtime run build && npm run test:node:jest
scripts.aeos:verify:full: npm run aeos:verify && npm run test:node:vitest && npm run test:node:mocha && npm run test:node:cucumber
scripts.test:java: npm run test:java:maven && npm run test:java:gradle
scripts.test:matrix:full: npm run aeos:verify:full && npm run test:java
scripts.test:all: npm run aeos:verify:full && npm run test:java
